Name: Maru's Baby-Toddler and Child Recolor
Author: Lucypandyleo
Description:
[size=3]nraittanna contacted me to make a baby recolor mod, so I'm helping with the sprites. It'll come out soon, but now I'm releasing earlier the recolors as I'm finishing them for each spouse for anyone interested.

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]Download the mod and extract it into the Mods folder
[/list]
Hope you like them! ^-^

[size=5]This mod won't be maintained, please check out [/size][size=5][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9500]this children recolor mod[/url] instead[/size][/size]
